pr_title: drivers: entropy_nrf5: Use device name and IRQ priority from DTS instead of Kconfig
pr_body:
Define rng nodes for all SoCs featuring the RNG peripheral and convert the entropy_nrf5 driver to use device name and interrupt properties from DTS, not Kconfig.

Provide also fixups for CONFIG_ENTROPY_NAME, until applications using entropy drivers are converted to use DTS as well.

For the network core in nRF5340, align the RNG interrupt priority with what is used as the default value in (almost) all other DTS nodes.

Fixes #24016.
pr_comments:

issue_context.title: Fully support DTS on nrf entropy driver
issue_context.body:
The NRF entropy driver is one of two remaining entropy drivers that haven't been converted to DTS.  The following changes need to be made:

* validate dts/bindings/rng/nordic,nrf-rng.yaml makes sense for all nrf SoCs
* Add dts nodes for entropy device to NRF dtsi files
* Convert driver to use DTS macros (especially replacing CONFIG_ENTROPY_NAME)

review_comments: Why are we not passing `nordic_nrf_nrg` to the `DT_INST_` macros instead of having to "hardcode it" at the top with the `#define DT_DRV_COMPAT	nordic_nrf_rng` ? I assume this is how it is intended to be done, but I find it a bit too little explicit. @galak @mbolivar

The idea of the DT_INST_ macros is that they utilize DT_DRV_COMPAT to reduce having a slew of `DT_INST(0, nordic_nrf_rng)` throughout the driver.  One is still free to use that style if they want or need to.
